display_long_description:
Master the virtual pitch in VR Football Soccer Simulator Pro, the ultimate Meta Quest VR soccer experience. Start with an in-depth tutorial to learn controls, then unleash your skills in richly detailed football (soccer) matches.

Perfect your ball shooting in attacking training, sharpen your reflexes in goalkeeper mode, and enjoy classic free-kick and penalty play styles. Take on intense Playoff matches, compete in World Cup mode, and enjoy the atmosphere of a world-class stadium filled with a lively audience.

Our game features high-fidelity 3D graphics and dynamic stadium crowds, making you feel the roar of the audience as you score. Choose your team from a world-class pool, select match length and settings, even flip a virtual coin on toss. Engage in intense Play-off brackets or a full World Cup mode with group stages and finals.

Key features:
•	Realistic Football Physics – Ball and player movements are fully physics-based
•	Immersive Atmosphere – Stunning visuals captured from pro players’ motions and stadium sounds make each match authentic.
•	Multiple Game Modes – Goalkeeper Mode, Free Kick, Penalty Shootout, Practice Drills, plus full-season tournaments.
•	Training Drills – Hone your passing, shooting, and goalkeeping in guided exercises.
•	Persistency – Save and resume games anytime; compete for top ranks.

Whether you want to score the winning goal or save the perfect shot, VR Football Soccer Simulator Pro delivers a complete VR football experience. Download now!
